title: External Integrations Module
summary: This module provides integrations with external toolsets like ACI.dev and LangChain, along with model-specific profiles for Groq and OpenAI Harmony, and a JSON schema transformer for OpenAI's strict mode.

nodes.label: Wrap ACI.dev Tools
nodes.title: ACI Toolset Wrapper
nodes.description: Provides a toolset that wraps ACI.dev functions, converting them into a compatible format for use within the Pydantic AI framework.

nodes.label: Wrap LangChain Tools
nodes.title: LangChain Toolset Wrapper
nodes.description: Offers a toolset that integrates LangChain tools, adapting them for seamless operation within the Pydantic AI ecosystem.

nodes.label: Define Groq Model Profile
nodes.title: Groq Model Profiler
nodes.description: Determines and returns the specific model profile for a given Groq model, including support for thinking capabilities and web search integration.

nodes.label: Define OpenAI Harmony Profile
nodes.title: OpenAI Harmony Profile
nodes.description: Generates a model profile tailored for the OpenAI Harmony Response format, adjusting settings like tool choice support and whitespace handling.

nodes.label: Transform OpenAI JSON Schema
nodes.title: OpenAI Schema Transformer
nodes.description: Recursively transforms JSON schemas to ensure compatibility with OpenAI's strict mode requirements, handling properties, required fields, and incompatible keywords.

groups.label: External Tool Wrappers
groups.title: External Tool Integrations
groups.description: Components responsible for integrating and adapting external tool frameworks into the Pydantic AI system.

groups.label: Model Profiles
groups.title: LLM Model Configuration Profiles
groups.description: Functions that define and retrieve specific configuration profiles for various Large Language Models, optimizing their behavior within the framework.

groups.label: Schema Adapters
groups.title: JSON Schema Adaptation
groups.description: Utilities for transforming and validating JSON schemas to meet specific external API requirements, such as OpenAI's strict mode.
